name: B10-0371/2025 (The Left) – Detention of EU citizens in the occupied areas of Cyprus
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the detention of EU citizens in the occupied areas of Cyprus
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of five Greek-Cypriot citizens held in the occupied part of Cyprus. It says they were arrested illegally on 19 July and brought before a military court on unfounded charges. It calls the detentions politically motivated and a violation of human rights. It asks the European Commission to pressure Türkiye to free them. It also restates its support for a reunited Cyprus as a two-community federation, rejecting a two-state solution. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament demands the immediate release of the five detained citizens.
- The five EU citizens are affected, along with Türkiye and the Turkish-Cypriot leadership.
- The Commission is asked to act; the resolution goes to EU institutions, Türkiye and Cyprus.
